mapper.select: SELECT id, work_type AS workType, work_id AS workId, action, operator, detail, created_at AS createdAt FROM activity_log WHERE work_type = #{workType} AND work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_log (work_type, work_id, action, operator, detail, created_at) VALUES (#{workType}, #{workId}, #{action}, #{operator}, #{detail}, #{createdAt})
